we introduce a novel deep second order attention mechanism into ConvNets, which can be plugged into intermediate layers and improve the nonlinearity and representational ability of ConvNets.

The main takeaway from our work is that
second order statistics of deep convolutional activations can be well modeled by attention mechanisms to guide the learning of convolution activations.
the second order statistics and the attention mechanisms are complementary to each other, and they can be jointly exploited to boost visual recognition performance.
